description: This Java class defines a Spring-managed Vert.x verticle that implements the TenantBackend interface for a file-based tenant storage. It primarily delegates tenant management operations to an instance of FileBasedTenantService, acting as a proxy or facade, and handles tenant-related API calls including add, read, update, remove, and retrieval by tenant ID or subject distinguished name.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantBackend
classes.description: A Spring stereotype component (Repository) that implements the TenantBackend interface and Verticle for tenant storage backed by a file, delegating operations to FileBasedTenantService.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Delegates adding a tenant with optional ID and tenant JSON object, providing tracing span and result handler.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Delegates reading tenant details by tenant ID with tracing span and result handler.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Delegates updating a tenant with ID, tenant JSON object, optional resource version, tracing span, and result handler.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Delegates removing a tenant by ID with optional resource version, tracing span, and result handler.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant data either by tenant ID or subject DN, via the tenantService.
